svg.title: Anatomy of a reducer
svg.desc: Edge messages are lifted into reducer state, merged pairwise by combine, and mapped to the node result by finalize. identity fills empty rows. The associativity and commutativity flags permit the combine tree to be reshaped; deterministic fixes its order.
svg.text: Anatomy of a reducer — one destination row

g.text: permit the combine tree to be reshaped
